review_scope: Read-only source sufficiency for supplemental MATPRE05/06; not an experimental result
findings: Actual counter/accessor sizes, literal overlay reconstruction, fresh World through 131080 ticks and uninterrupted frame clocks jointly distinguish natural E16 rollover from forced storage clearing.
Numeric cell epochs are not in every semantic frame; frames retain current-stamp predicates. Frozen source and typed transition/sentinel receipts remain essential.
Natural E16 coverage is one phased worker and 256 resident cells; ordinary four-worker and large forced-clear fixtures are separate coverage.
S1 elapsed durations do not rank layouts; correctness observers, capture, build-mode differences and no AB/BA pairs preclude performance inference.
Eager chunk tails establish the declared dense ownership policy; they do not establish sparse optional state, whole-process RSS savings or GEN-006 continuation.
Observed background task counts do not identify four distinct workers or establish simultaneous execution; ASan/UBSan is not race-detector coverage.
